patch_description: Structural redesign around a single fused pipeline: (1) a shared adaptive two-state Kalman engine parameterized by direction, run forward and backward over the signal; (2) fusion of forward/backward levels and velocities via variance weights (RTS-like blend, near-zero phase); (3) an inline deadband applied directly to the fused velocity to suppress false reversals — with a compensating level correction folded into the same loop rather than a stacked stabilizer stage; (4) a final light median pass over the fused output for residual spike removal. This reorganization replaces the previous w-blend of levels with a proper velocity-aware fusion, and integrates reversal suppression locally, targeting the high false-reversal count (237.8) and slope changes (302.8) while retaining the low lag (0.22) and high correlation (0.96).
